title: TimeTok: Granularity-Controllable Time-Series Generation via Hierarchical Tokenization
abstract: arXiv:2605.01418v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time-series data are inherently multiscale, spanning diverse temporal granularities from coarse trends to fine-scale dynamics. However, existing time-series generative models provide limited control over the temporal granularity of both inputs and outputs, restricting their ability to condition on user-provided coarse sketches and generate samples at a desired target granularity. To address this, we introduce TimeTok, a unified framework for Granularity-Controllable Time-Series Generation (GC-TSG), which generates time series at any target granularity from any coarser input (e.g., rough sketches) or without conditioning. At the core of TimeTok is a hierarchical tokenization strategy that maps time series into an ordered sequence of tokens, from coarse to fine temporal granularity. Our autoregressive generation process operates across these granularity levels, producing token blocks that are decoded back into continuous time series. T

translated_title: TimeTok：基于分层标记化的粒度可控时间序列生成
translated_abstract: 时间序列数据本质上是多尺度的，涵盖从粗粒度趋势到细粒度动态的多种时间粒度。然而，现有的时间序列生成模型对输入和输出的时间粒度控制能力有限，这限制了它们以用户提供的粗略草图作为条件、并按期望的目标粒度生成样本的能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TimeTok，一个用于粒度可控时间序列生成（GC-TSG）的统一框架，它能够从任意更粗的输入（例如粗略草图）出发，或在无条件情况下，以任意目标粒度生成时间序列。TimeTok的核心是一种分层标记化策略，该策略将时间序列映射为按时间粒度从粗到细排列的有序标记序列。我们的自回归生成过程跨越这些粒度级别进行，生成标记块，并将其解码回连续的时间序列。
tldr: TimeTok提出了一种分层标记化策略，将时间序列编码为从粗到细的有序标记序列，从而实现从任意粗粒度输入（如粗略草图）或无条件情况下，以任意目标时间粒度可控地生成时间序列。
en_tdlr: TimeTok introduces a hierarchical tokenization strategy that encodes time series into ordered coarse-to-fine token sequences, enabling granularity-controllable generation at any target temporal granularity from coarse sketches or without conditioning.
